ticket.subject: Email notifications down
ticket.body_text:
Hey team,

No notification emails have gone out from any of our workspaces since 11:35 UTC, so our customers are not getting their receipts.

Two other companies we work with see the same problem. The email log in the admin area is empty for today.

We have a hard deadline tomorrow morning, so please treat this as urgent. Please treat this as an incident.

Many thanks,
Aisha Rasmussen
head of finance, Ottervale Software

label_notes: clean outage (outage-emails): a core service is down for many customers, so outage P1; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
